scripts.models:build: blender --background --factory-startup --python tools/blender/make_sportscar.py -- public/models/sportscar.raw.glb && node tools/compress-model.ts public/models/sportscar.raw.glb public/models/sportscar.glb && blender --background --factory-startup --python tools/blender/make_traffic.py -- public/models/traffic.raw.glb && node tools/compress-model.ts public/models/traffic.raw.glb public/models/traffic.glb && npm run models:cars && npm run models:landmarks && npm run models:vegetation && npm run models:props && npm run models:shops && npm run models:houses
scripts.models:landmarks: blender --background --factory-startup --python tools/blender/make_landmarks.py && for f in public/models/landmarks/*.raw.glb; do node tools/compress-model.ts "$f" "${f%.raw.glb}.glb"; done
scripts.models:vegetation: blender --background --factory-startup --python tools/blender/make_vegetation.py && node tools/compress-model.ts public/models/vegetation.raw.glb public/models/vegetation.glb
scripts.models:props: blender --background --factory-startup --python tools/blender/make_props.py && node tools/compress-model.ts public/models/props.raw.glb public/models/props.glb
scripts.models:bridges: blender --background --factory-startup --python tools/blender/make_bridges.py && blender --background --factory-startup --python tools/blender/make_bridge_heroes.py && for f in public/models/landmarks/bruecke-*.raw.glb; do node tools/compress-model.ts "$f" "${f%.raw.glb}.glb"; done
scripts.models:cars: blender --background --factory-startup --python tools/blender/make_hothatch.py && blender --background --factory-startup --python tools/blender/make_gt.py && blender --background --factory-startup --python tools/blender/make_muscle.py && blender --background --factory-startup --python tools/blender/make_rally.py && blender --background --factory-startup --python tools/blender/make_hyper.py && for c in hothatch gt muscle rally hyper; do node tools/compress-model.ts public/models/cars/$c.raw.glb public/models/cars/$c.glb; done
scripts.models:import: for c in coupe sedan goblin; do node tools/import-car.ts $c; done
scripts.models:shops: blender --background --factory-startup --python tools/blender/make_shops.py && node tools/compress-model.ts public/models/shops.raw.glb public/models/shops.glb
scripts.models:houses: blender --background --factory-startup --python tools/blender/make_houses.py && node tools/compress-model.ts public/models/houses.raw.glb public/models/houses.glb
